name: The Looter
description:
About This Game

Carefully aim your repeater pistol at a huge mosquito and down the bulging insect with two well-placed shots, jump down the ledge of a dilapidated building reclaimed by arborescent vegetation, dodge acidic slime thrown by a hideous mutant, and bury a blood-red fire axe in its disgusting head. This is the adrenaline-fueled thrill of The Looter.

A lone scavenger is sent on a dangerous mission to the legendary Monastyr. The journey takes them deep into Tortura, a vast, post-apocalyptic land where twisted forests and desolate deserts hide the decaying monuments of a past civilization. To survive, they must fight ruthless creatures and uncover dark secrets.

KEY FEATURES

  • Intense Combat: Master a variety of firearms like pistols, shotguns, and assault rifles with a full 360-degree aiming system. When enemies get too close, your trusty fire axe is a last resort, backed up by grenades and landmines to ensure your survival.

  • Deep Exploration: Navigate the vast, somber landscape of Tortura. Search overgrown ruins, deserted bunkers, and empty bases to uncover valuable loot.

  • Hidden Secrets: Be perceptive to uncover every secret the world keeps from you. Unearth lore, find hidden places, and discover artifacts that will aid your journey.

  • Loot & Crafting: Find artifacts and materials to combine and craft into new tools and equipment. Tailor your gear to your playstyle as you discover new blueprints and recipes.

  • Compelling Story: Face dangerous strangers and ruthless creatures on your adventure. Uncover the tragic history of Tortura and the great evil lurking in the shadows.
short_desc: The post-apocalyptic land of Tortura is a decaying world of overgrown ruins that devoured the last traces of humanity. In The Looter, a lone scavenger navigates its depths, facing mutated animals, vile abominations, and dangerous strangers. Uncovering hidden secrets is key to survival.
